description: This file implements the 'merge-base' command for Git, providing functionality for finding common ancestors of commits, including different modes such as 'all', 'octopus', 'independent', 'is-ancestor', and 'fork-point'. It handles various command-line options, fetches commit objects, and outputs merge base information.

methods.name: int show_merge_base(struct commit ** rev,size_t rev_nr,int show_all)
methods.description: Computes and displays the merge base(s) for given commits, supporting options to show all bases or just the first one.

methods.name: struct:commit * get_commit_reference(const char * arg)
methods.description: Resolves a commit reference given an argument string, returning a commit object.

methods.name: int handle_independent(int count,const char ** args)
methods.description: Handles 'independent' mode, listing commits not reachable from others.

methods.name: int handle_octopus(int count,const char ** args,int show_all)
methods.description: Handles 'octopus' mode, finding merge bases for multiple commits.

methods.name: int handle_is_ancestor(int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Handles the '--is-ancestor' option, checking if one commit is ancestor of another.

methods.name: int handle_fork_point(int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Handles 'fork-point' mode, determining where a commit forked from a ref.

methods.name: int cmd_merge_base(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main command function parsing arguments and dispatching to specific modes.

ctags.name: cmd_merge_base
ctags.signature: (int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)

ctags.name: handle_octopus
ctags.pattern: /^static int handle_octopus(int count, const char **args, int show_all)$/

ctags.name: show_merge_base
ctags.pattern: /^static int show_merge_base(struct commit **rev, size_t rev_nr, int show_all)$/
